title: Khoon barsa
body:
khoon barsa khoon barsa
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon barsa na barasna tha na badal barse
ek ek khatre ko pani ke shah e deen tarse
khoon barsa khoon barsa
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas jab hadh se badi ro ke sakina ne kaha
door kitni hai chacha nehr batao ghar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kahan khaak pe baithi ho sakina utho
kaun aaya hai palat kar jo gaya ran ghar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghurkiyan shimr ki kahin jo kiya baap ko yaad
kaan ke dard se royi to tamache barse
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi shabbir hai zinda wahin tehro zainab
tum ko akbar ki qasam tum na nikalna ghar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere nana ke madine tujhe zainab ka salaam
thokare khaa ke palat aayi hoo main dar dar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq o baatil ka ho takrao to dil ladte hai
jang ye jeeti nahi jaati kabhi lashkar se
khoon barsa khoon barsa...
